_comment: TRAP progressions. Chord progressions are freely copyable (settled law -- see docs/idiom-research/legal.md); these are the harmonic families from docs/idiom-research/genre-hiphop.md section 2.2. All minor by design: major keys are effectively banned in the idiom (static i dominates, colors come from bVI/bVII/b2). Natural-minor diatonic triads: 3=bIII, 6=bVI, 7=bVII; the Andalusian V is forced major (harmonic minor).
